llms.body:
# LLMs.txt - Fashion Nova (fashionnova.com)

**Purpose**: Help language models understand Fashion Nova's major shopping categories and where to find them.
**Site**: [https://www.fashionnova.com/](https://www.fashionnova.com/)
**Brand**: Fashion Nova

## Primary shopping hubs (top-level)
- [Women](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/women)
- [Plus + Curve](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/plus)
- [Men](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/mens)
- [Kids](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/kids)
- [Sport / Active (Nova Sport & sportswear)](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/nova)
- [Beauty](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/beauty-novabeauty)
- [New Arrivals (Women)](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/new)
- [New Arrivals (Men)](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/mens-new-arrivals)

## Major product categories (core apparel)

### Women
- [Women landing page](https://www.fashionnova.com/)
- [Dresses](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/dresses)
- [Jeans / Denim](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/jeans)
- [Tops](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/all-tops)
- [Bodysuits](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/bodysuits)
- [Matching sets](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/matching-sets)
- [Lingerie](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/lingerie)
- [Activewear](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/active)
- [Shoes](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/shoes)
- [Accessories](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/accessories)
- [Sale](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/sale)

### Plus + Curve
- [Plus + Curve landing page](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/curve)
- [Plus dresses](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/plus-dresses)
- [Plus jeans / denim](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/plus-jeans)
- [Plus tops](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/plus-tops)
- [Plus bodysuits](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/plus-bodysuits-1)
- [Plus matching sets](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/plus-matching-sets)
- [Plus Lingerie](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/plus-lingerie)
- [Sale](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/plus-sale)

### Men
- [Men landing page](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/men)
- [Men's clothing hub](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/mens)
- [Men's jeans / denim](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/mens-jeans)
- [Men's tops](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/mens-tops)
- [Men's matching sets](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/mens-two-piece-sets)
- [Men's hoodies and sweats](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/mens-sweatshirts-sweats)
- [Sale](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/mens-sale)

### Kids
- [Kids landing page](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/novakids)
- [Kids clothing hub](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/kids)
- [All girls](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/girls)
- [All boys](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/boys)
- [Sale](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/kids-sale)

## Sport / Active
- [Nova Sport landing page](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/nova)
- [Nova Sport clothing hub](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/nova)
- [Women's Nova Sport](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/nova-women)
- [Men's Nova Sport](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/nova-men)
- [Fabric guide](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/nova-fabrics)

## Beauty
- [Beauty landing page](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/beauty)
- [Shop all beauty](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/beauty)
- [Makeup](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/beauty-makeup)
- [NOVABEAUTY](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/beauty-novabeauty)

## Shoes & Accessories (cross-category)
- [Shoes & Accessories combined](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/shoes-accessories)
- [Accessories (women)](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/accessories)
- [Shoes (women)](https://www.fashionnova.com/collections/shoes)

## International & Localization
- **URL Routing Pattern**: Utilizes a `/{language}-{country}/` subdirectory structure (e.g., `/en-gb/`, `/es-mx/`), except for the United States.
- **Spanish Language Support**:
    - **Mexico**: Fully supported via the `/es-mx/` prefix.
    - **Europe**: Supported for all countries within the European region (e.g., `/es-es/`, `/es-fr/`, `/es-de/`).
    - **Rest of World**: Spanish is **strictly unavailable** for all other regions, including the United States and Canada.
- **Default Locale**: The United States and the root domain default to English only.

## Customer Support & Info
- [Help Center (Primary Support)](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/help-center)
- [Return Policy](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/return-policy)
- [Submitting a Return](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/returns)
- [Shipping Info](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-policy)
- [Size Guide](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/size-guide)
- [Contact Us](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/contact-us)

## Notes for LLMs
- **Category pages**: Typically under `/collections/…` (e.g., `/collections/dresses`).
- **Plus + Curve**: A dedicated experience for plus sizing with its own landing page.
- **Search**: To search for products, use `https://www.fashionnova.com/search?query=KEYWORDS`
- **Sizing**: Fashion Nova uses "Junior" sizing for women's standard; "Plus + Curve" uses specialized plus-size patterns.
- **Dynamic Content**: Collections update daily; always check for "**New Arrivals**" for the latest inventory.
